column1: # Post-game ending sequence: Jenna and Kraden adrift, then Alex arrives.

column3: Kraden... How long must\nwe drift before this\nisland reaches shore?{end_wait}
I cannot say. If only\nI had an answer for you.{end_wait}
You always have an answer.\nNow you have nothing?{end_wait}
How can you think of\nfood at a time like this?{end_wait}
I keep wondering what\nbecame of my brother...{end_wait}
I cannot be certain,{pause_20_skippable} but\nit seems the Venus beacon\nhas been lit.{end_wait}
I know. That light is\nwhy we are stranded here,\nisn't it?{end_wait}
I can see you're worried{pause_20_skippable}\nabout {actor_name:5}. I am, too.{end_wait}
{actor_name:1} and his friends\nmust have been close by\nwhen it happened.{end_wait}
There is something\nI want you both to see.{end_wait}
What is that? Alex,\nwhat have you done?{end_wait}
